monster_village_guardian.title: the
monster_village_guardian.name: last guardian
monster_village_guardian.information: This gigantic beast seems to protect the bar. It is really, really big, and has a huge health pool. You want to really kill this one quick.
death_messages: You found an unsurprising end against the village guardian.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} flex{atk.es} {atk.poss_adjective} leg in preparation of a nasty kick!
text.on_kill: {atk.name} kicks {def.name} with {atk.poss_adjective} massive foreleg, and reduces {def.subject} to a pile of flesh and {def.blood}!
text.on_dodge: {def.name} manage{def.s} to narrowly avoid the kick with a desperate leap!
text.on_armor_save: {def.name} simply tank{def.s} the kick with {def.poss_adjective} massive armor!

monster_goblin1.title: the
monster_goblin1.name: one-eyed goblin geezer
monster_goblin1.information: This old, one-eyed Goblin has his best days behind him. Killing him should be no problem. But just think of his remaining family... Do you really want to kill the grandpa of 23 goblin children?
death_messages: You somehow did it. You got defeated by an old cripple of goblin. I would give you an medal, but unfortunately you got eaten by 23 hungry goblin children. You are dead.

text.on_hit: With what little power is left in {atk.poss_adjective} old bones, {atk.name} hit{atk.s} {def.name} in the face!
text.on_kill: {atk.name} hit{atk.s} {def.name} in the mouth, and {def.name} choke{def.s} and suffocate{def.s} on the knuckle sandwich!
text.on_dodge: {def.name} avoid{def.s} the punch without any trouble.
text.on_armor_save: Due to {def.owns} armor, the hit hurts {atk.name} more than it hurts {def.name}.

monster_fat_cat.title: the
monster_fat_cat.name: really fat cat
monster_fat_cat.information: Wow, this cat is REALLY fat. Shes slow, but quite tanky because of her fat belly . Maybe you should try fire?
death_messages: The cat *mistakes* you for a sofa, and completely scratches your skin of. You are dead.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} watch{atk.es} {def.name}, waiting for an opportunity to strike.
text.on_kill: {atk.name} scratches {def.name} too many times to count!
text.on_dodge: {atk.owns} scratch tears up the air, but not much else.
text.on_armor_save: {atk.owns} attack fails to put a scratch into {def.owns} armor.

monster_demon_baby.title: the
monster_demon_baby.name: Devilish Suckling
monster_demon_baby.information: This is a baby, possessed by the devil. It doesnt have much health, but explodes when you bring it in contact with fire. So be careful!
death_messages: It thinks you are its Mother! How cute! Except it killed all 243 mothers before. And so you. You are dead.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} call{atk.s} out to {atk.poss_adjective} father in hell for a curse most wicked!
text.on_kill: {atk.name} hex{atk.es} {def.name} with a devilish curse, causing {def.poss_adjective} heart to stop!
text.on_dodge: Through divine intervention, {atk.owns} curse is avoided!

text.wind_up: {atk.name} explode{atk.s} violently upon contact with fire!
text.on_hit: {def.name} is caught up in the explosion!
text.on_kill: {def.name} is caught up in the explosion and burnt to a crisp!
text.on_dodge: {def.name} barely manage{def.s} to duck behind a piece of rubble right in time before the explosion!
text.on_armor_save: {def.name} stand{def.s} unfazed, {def.poss_adjective} armor protecting {def.object} from the blast!

monster_pigeon.title: the
monster_pigeon.name: pigeon of doom
monster_pigeon.information: This pigeon is really annoying. In fact, it is so annoying that you just want to kill it. Which is pretty easy, because its an goddamn pigeon.
death_messages: It picks out your eyes, and while stumbling around blindly, you fall with your head into your weapon. You are dead.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} circle{atk.s} {def.name}, waiting for an opportunity to strike!
text.on_hit: {atk.name} swiftly swoop{atk.s} in and peck{atk.s} at {def.owns} eyes!
text.on_kill: {atk.name} swiftly swoop{atk.s} in, and blinds {def.name}! This leaves {def.object}
text.on_dodge: {atk.name} flies to fast to react when {def.name} move{def.s}, and misses.

monster_villager.title: the
monster_villager.name: blood-lusting villager
monster_villager.information: A villager, corrupted by the evening of bloodlust. He has a flail, along with a rusty sickle.
death_messages: He flails your bones to dust. While they are still in your body. You are dead.
He cuts your throat with his sickle, and lustfully drinks your blood directly out of you carotid artery. You are dead.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} hold{atk.s} {atk.poss_adjective} flail high above {atk.poss_adjective} head in preparation for a vicious strike.
text.on_armor_save: {atk.owns} flail strike falls flat against {def.owns} armor.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} hold{atk.s} in front of {atk.object}, ready to strike.
text.on_hit: {atk.name} slashes at {def.name}, leaving a nasty cut!
